commenti.body:
What kind of truefilm-level analysis do you want for a post like this?

Unless their favorite movie is like, Birth of a Nation or Triumph of the Will, I don't think a taste in movies is a red flag at all.

Nothing about her choices are a red flag, but is not obvious why she wouldn’t enjoy the lighthouse? Joker is just violent with a dark overtone. There’s nothing particularly shocking there. The Lighthouse is a slow, drawn out, abstract, low budget artsy movie in black and white featuring willem dafoe fucking an octopus or something with a bunch of cum and all kinds of shit out of left field. It makes perfect sense why that would turn someone off lol I love The Lighthouse btw, but it’s pretty obvious why someone wouldn’t be into it
It’s a little crazy to me that we look at a movie costing $11 million as low budget.
Low budget may not be the right term. I was just using it colloquially to describe it’s subtlety (and then I guess towards the end its not so subtlety)

Yeah I get you. I don’t even blame you for using that term because that’s probably the way it’s marketed. 

It seems like they spent a lot of money on it for what it is, though. Like you could probably comfortably make this for 1/5 the budget they had.
You’re trying too hard. It’s pretty evident from this post that you’re desperately trying to pander to the taste of this sub and are desperate for upvotes/the approval of other users on here.
